items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: old man Kimball on bass. Kendall's daddy, you know.

ctx.x: Piron said, what the fuck? I'm going to do that. I'm going to do that.

I'm going to run them off this boat. I'm going to get them fired. Boy, we'd be falling out there. Jimmy said, that's right. That's right. Fist. That's right. Fist. Boy, we'd fall out there. Jimmy did it. He was a comical guy. Jimmy was a comical guy. Jimmy Jones. Yeah, he was out in Des Moines. He come on the boat when Simon taken sick. Him and Kim will die out, see. Mm-hm. Simon and Elliot, see, taken sick. Where was Kendall Dioe? Where was Kendall Dioe? Jimmy did it. He was. Oh, boy. Jimmy was a comical guy.…
Yes, around St. Louis. Did you ever know Harry Dile, the drummer?
